mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned La Parrilla silver mine complex, Durango, Mexico (acquired Aug 2023 from First Majestic). Past producer: 34.3M AgEq oz produced 2005-2019; 41 concessions (69,478 ha), 2,000 tpd processing plant, 5 underground mines + open pit. On care and maintenance; restart targeted: company obtained non-binding debt/offtake-linked financing proposals of C$15-17M (May 2025, subject to conditions) and raised C$12M (June 2025) to fund restart activities. Restart production target ~3M AgEq oz/yr. March 2025 MRE update: indicated 10.8M AgEq oz (+107%); inferred 16.3M AgEq oz (+58%); mostly sulphide, silver-dominant; 23 new mineralized structures identified. 2% NSR royalty to First Majestic. No production in FY2025.

100%-owned undeveloped silver asset, Durango, Mexico (91.65 ha). Historical estimates of 220-300M AgEq oz in resources (not verified to current standards; conceptual). Exploration-stage; no production.
